content.title: How to watch Kentucky vs. Iowa State men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 22
content.text: The No. 2 seed Iowa State Cyclones (28-7) look to advance to the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament when they play the No. 7 seed Kentucky Wildcats (22-13) on Sunday at 2:45 p.m. ET.How to watch Kentucky Wildcats vs. Iowa State Cyclones Venue: Enterprise Center Time: 2:45 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Kentucky vs. Iowa State odds Spread: Iowa State -4.5 (-123), Kentucky +4.5 (-104) Favorite Moneyline: Iowa State -233 Underdog Moneyline: Kentucky +187 Total: 146.5 Total Over Odds: -113 Total Under Odds: -110 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Iowa State is outscoring opponents by 17.1 points per game with a +600 scoring differential overall. It puts up 82.5 points per game (46th in college basketball) and allows 65.4 per outing (13th in college basketball). Iowa State connects on 1.6 more threes per game than the opposition, 9.1 (84th in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 7.5. Kentucky is outscoring opponents by 6.9 points per game, with a +241 scoring differential overall. It puts up 81.0 points per game (65th in college basketball) and gives up 74.1 per outing (187th in college basketball). Kentucky makes 8.1 three-pointers per game (150th in college basketball) at a 34.2% rate (169th in college basketball), compared to the 7.5 its opponents make, shooting 31.8% from deep.
